name: spill
description: spill with {"list": true} must list spill directories as ok:true without requiring any spilled file to exist. Goes red when fs_prefixes or the spill serialization breaks; stays green on empty state/spills.
prompt: Use the spill tool with input {"list": true}. Look at the tool's JSON result. If its ok field is true and it has a spills or list field, reply with exactly SHAPE_OK. Otherwise reply with exactly SHAPE_BAD.
